title: Chautauqua Institution, New York
description: Explore a miniature of Chautauqua Institution, from Elm Gate to Bryant Gate: Bestor Plaza, historic halls, music cabins, the Amphitheater, Athenaeum Hotel, and Chautauqua Lake.
